name: Teoma Zhigulin
summary: Instagram account recovery client referred by 'Sherlock', seeking to get the disabled/banned account @teoma_zhigulin back after Meta gave no appeal option. Was quoted $2700, pushed back on the price and asked what the service actually does, then agreed on 2026-08-30 ('I'm down let's do it') and provided a login code and handle. Account still not recovered as of 2026-10-16; client has chased for updates repeatedly (Sep 5, 6, 8, Oct 7, 12, 16) and Derrek replied he believes it's still being worked on. Needs a status update and clear next steps after the link submission.
key_facts: Quoted $2700 for Instagram account recovery; client questioned price and asked for a better one
Client agreed to proceed on 2026-08-30 and shared a login code (056686)
No appeal option was available on this account; client appealed on a different account of theirs
Client asked for guidance on avoiding future bans
Multiple unanswered follow-ups from Sep 5 through Oct 16; case still open and overdue
Client submitted a link at some point and asked what the next step is (Oct 7)
services_discussed: Advice on avoiding future Instagram bans
